rationales.A: Stoppages rose from 485 to 1,572, so they did not fall.
rationales.B: Both columns rise, so neither fell.

rationales.D: Stoppages rose from 485 to 1,572 and workers from 165,000 to 610,000, a sharp rise in both.
rationales.general:
Compare the two columns, year by year.
1. In 1884 there were 485 stoppages and 165,000 workers involved.
2. In 1885 both numbers rise, to 695 and 258,000.
3. In 1886 both jump again, to 1,572 and 610,000.
4. So between 1884 and 1886, both columns rose sharply.
5. A rise in both columns at once is a surge, not a drift.
Remember: a pattern question needs both columns checked, not just one.
